xor.controlContract: Mandatory P01 structural baseline for independently authored P15 fixture
xor.protocol: Three independently launched alternating windows with three warmups and nine measurements per process; two additional alternating confirmation windows when any initial ratio exceeds 1.05. Native batches: admission64/fresh16/cycle1. WASM batches: admission64/fresh64/cycle1. Fresh runs immediately resume every public yield; cycle additionally saves/restores at quantum one. Both include protocol encoding and outcome decoding. No exclusive-host claim.

measurementNotes: The frozen P14 semantic compiler produces byte-identical controls. Structural and local comparisons therefore share exact input/image tuples.

XOR WASM fresh samples use batches of 64. For Boolean arguments exceeding 8192 bytes, the sampler uses batches of one, preserving three warmups and nine samples per independently launched window. Boolean raw controller protocol text predates this adjustment; samplesPerBatch records the actual count. Other Boolean fresh cells use 64. Native uses 16. Pair order, repetitions and confirmation rules are unchanged.
All timing processes ran after builds stopped. Boundary construction cost has no World timing cap. No exclusive-host claim.

WASM memory is working payload, excludes host input/output and RSS; quantum1 and quantum64 checkpoint peaks are distinct. Deepest-return checkpoint observations measure retained administrative context, not total process peak.

Existing pre-cutover consumer comparisons remain in prior reports. All 18 Agent images are byte-identical to P14; their earlier costs and unresolved M3/P13 decisions are not reclassified. These new synthetic fixtures have no historical application timing to relabel.
